title: Financial Decision Making
modules: Buying And Selling Of Common Stocks
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of choosing the proportions of various assets to be held in a portfolio, in such a way as to make the portfolio better than any other according to some criterion."

Portfolio optimization is the process of choosing the proportions of various assets to be held in a portfolio, in such a way as to make the portfolio better than any other according to some criterion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the world's most capital intensive businesses today."
The oil industry is one of the world's most capital intensive businesses today.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the risk of a decline in investment returns because of market factors independent of the given security or property investment."
Market risk is the risk of a decline in investment returns because of market factors independent of the given security or property investment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the date in the future on which the investor's principal will be repaid."
The maturity date is the date in the future on which the investor's principal will be repaid.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount the bondholder will receive as interest pa yments."
The coupon is the amount the bondholder will receive as interest pa yments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the risk of not being able to liquidate an investment conveniently and at a reasonable price."
Liquidity risk is the risk of not being able to liquidate an investment conveniently and at a reasonable price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex process based on expectations of the return and risk behaviour of a stock."
Determining a security's investment worth is a complex process based on expectations of the return and risk behaviour of a stock.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scientific activity that aims to make a particular part or feature of the world easier to understand, define, quantify, visualize, or simulate."
Modelling is a scientific activity that aims to make a particular part or feature of the world easier to understand, define, quantify, visualize, or simulate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential element in the buying and selling of common stock."
Keeping track of current prices is an essential element in the buying and selling of common stock.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with scientifically deciding how to best design and operate man-machine systems, usually under conditions requiring the allocation of scarce resources."
Operations research is concerned with scientifically deciding how to best design and operate man-machine systems, usually under conditions requiring the allocation of scarce resources.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a graphical representation of the CAPM formula."
The SML is a graphical representation of the CAPM formula.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a model for pricing an individual security or portfolio."
The CAPM is a model for pricing an individual security or portfolio.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the construction of the covariance matrix for the rates of return on the assets in the portfolio."
Central to this optimization is the construction of the covariance matrix for the rates of return on the assets in the portfolio.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a forward looking activity, and thus the covariances of returns and risk levels must be forecast rather than observed."
Investment is a forward looking activity, and thus the covariances of returns and risk levels must be forecast rather than observed.
